__NOTOC__ The Cursed Ghoulfish is a fish that can be caught in Khaz Algar. These fish are both an important component to certain Cooking recipes and a nuisance to anglers, given that catching them adds the . The curse hexes those who carry the Ghoulfish with poor luck in their casts for five minutes. The buff cannot be removed except by right-clicking the Ghoulfish and throwing it back into the water, which grants a fifteen-minute boon that gives the thrower fifteen additional Perception. Ghoulfish are most commonly caught from the morbid Blood in the Water, though they can rarely be caught from other pools within and the open waters of Hallowfall and Azj-Kahet. Cyberlore Studios was a video game developer recognized for co-developing Warcraft II: Beyond the Dark Portal, the official expansion to Blizzard's classic RTS . Their work expanded the lore of Azeroth with new campaigns and maps, marking a rare external collaboration in Blizzard's early history.

A cursed gnomish expedition occupied the Cursed Landing and adjacent areas on the eastern coast of Uldum during the Cataclysm. They accidentally released an ancient tomb curse that drove them insane and made them obsessed with trying to access the region's re-origination technology to remake Azeroth.

DBC (DataBaseClient) is the file format that functions as the clientside database, containing data about achievements, the Adventure Guide, items, NPCs, the environment, the world, and much more. Most of these files from the start of World of Warcraft to patch 3.3.5a ended with the extension ".dbc". Patch 4.0.1 introduced a more complex variant of the file format as the ".db2".

Damaged Arcane Relics are located at the Tranquil Strand on the Isle of Dorn.
Dalaran Spellguard is a human fighting Queensguard Zirix in Tranquil Strand on the Isle of Dorn.
Damp Sandcoursers are sandstorm elementals located on the southwestern coast on the Isle of Dorn.

Dalaran Survivors are found sitting in Thraegar Rest, Keepers Terrace, and Stonelight Rest in Dornogal. They can spawn as a: *high elf of the Silver Covenant or the Kirin Tor *blood elf of the Sunreavers *human of the Kirin Tor *gnome of the Kirin Tor
Dalaran Guardian's Arcanotool drops from Zovex at the Tranquil Strand on the Isle of Dorn.
Dalian Ironlink is a dead Arathi located at Stillstone Pond in Hallowfall, encountered during Those Who Fell. Dalian Ironlink's Tinderbox belonged to him.

Damp Ransom Note is found at attached to the top-left corner of Alyx's call board at the central pavilion outside the Caverns of Time in Tanaris after asking her for difficult riddles. This is part of Guest Relations. It reads: The suspiciously capitalized words point to the Dive Bar at in Zuldazar. Purchase a Clam Digger from Nikto inside the Dive Bar itself, then head to Gerald at on the upper side of the west edge, and feed it to the conch, revealing the Soggy Celebration Crate.

Damaged Undermine Supply Crate is sold by Pix Xizzix in Booty Bay for . It contains a random assortment of crafting materials, but will always include Ahn'Qiraj materials such as idols, scarabs, or the following crafting materials: *Ancient Sandworm Bile *Hive Thistle *Monstrous Silithid Chitin *Qiraji Silk *Qiraji Stalker Venom *Spiked Silithid Chitin
The Damaged Silver Hand Breastplate can be found in Andorhal in the for the quest The Ruins of Andorhal. Interacting with it will cause the spirit of Uther the Lightbringer to appear.
Dander is an imperial lynx located in Torchlight Mine in Hallowfall.
Daman Mills is a voice actor who has provided several voices for World of Warcraft.

Dalaran Experiments are creatures that were captured for study and were experiments in the dungeons of Dalaran. They were encountered by Kael'thas Sunstrider, Lady Vashj, and their blood elf and naga minions.

A Damp Passage Downwards is found at the bottom of Campalot in the Ringing Deeps. It leads to a cave below, in which the Lady of the Lake resides. The remains of two Questing Knights as well as an Unfortunate Goblin can be found here. A Damp Passage Upwards leads back up.
A Damp Passage Upwards is found in the cave, reached through the Damp Passage Downwards, at the bottom Campalot in the Ringing Deeps. It leads back up.
Dam Service Tunnel connects the exterior of The Waterworks with The G.R.I.D. in Operation: Floodgate.
Damned Warriors are skeletal vrykul summoned by Reisa the Drowned in the Shrouded Coast in the Forbidden Reach.
Dampened Bones are bone golems located in the Forbidden Reach.
Damaged Buzzspire 505 is found at the Froststone Peak in the Forbidden Reach.

The Dalaran Portal to Caverns of Time is a portal in the Violet Citadel in Dalaran in Northrend. It is located just up the main stairs from the entrance and to the left (opposite the Portal to The Purple Parlor). It leads to the Caverns of Time in Tanaris.
Damplight Skitterers are spiders located in an unnamed cave with Forgotten Smuggler's Stash near Old Drust Road in Tiragarde Sound. They appear after approaching webs.
Damaged Eburine Jewel can drop from a Hellcaller Chest during the A Greedy Emissary event.
Damaged Echo Surveyor is located at Shahata's camp south of North Sufaad on K'aresh. She is looking for it in We Are Our Words.
Damp Repair Kits are looted from Repair Kits during the "Goblin Mischief" story variant in Tak-Rethan Abyss.
Damp Doll is a trash item that can be fished up in Khaz Algar. They are also sold Lonomia in Razorwind Shores for .
Damaged Radial Cog can be looted from Keeper's Stashes on the Isle of Dorn.
Dance of Midnight is the apex talent for Blood death knights.
Danath Loyalists are humans located in Stromgarde Keep in the Arathi Highlands during Rise of the Red Dawn (quest).

Dalaran Kafa Grinder is housing decor that can be purchased for 10 Community Coupons from Brother Dovetail, who appears in neighborhoods as part of the Friend of the Grummles endeavor. This item becomes purchasable after the neighborhood has reached the third milestone on the Endeavor Progress bar.

Dalaran Kafa Table is housing decor that can be purchased for 10 Community Coupons from Brother Dovetail, who appears in neighborhoods as part of the Friend of the Grummles endeavor. This item becomes purchasable after the neighborhood has reached the third milestone on the Endeavor Progress bar.

Dalaran Espresso Machine is housing decor that can be purchased for 15 Community Coupons from Brother Dovetail, who appears in neighborhoods as part of the Friend of the Grummles endeavor. This item becomes purchasable after the neighborhood has reached the fourth milestone on the Endeavor Progress bar.
Damaged Argus Constructs are inactive vigilants found at Azurelight Square in Eredath when Core Mechanics is up.
Dame Bloodshed is a lynx located at Fairbreeze Village in Eversong Woods.
Dance Gear can be found by engineers in treasure chests located throughout Midnight zones. Only 1 can be looted per week.
Dalaran Post is housing decor created with Northrend Inscription (60). The recipe is taught by trainers.
Dalaran Runic Anvil is housing decor created with Northrend Blacksmithing (60). The recipe is taught by trainers.
